title: Crazy
lyrics:
[00:03.058] I remember when, I remember, I remember when I lost my mind
[00:08.912] There was something so pleasant about that place.
[00:12.370] Even your emotions had an echo
[00:14.533] In so much space

[00:20.338] And when you're out there
[00:21.760] Without care,
[00:22.681] Yeah, I was out of touch
[00:26.039] But it wasn't because I didn't know enough
[00:31.316] I just knew too much

[00:35.683] Does that make me crazy?
[00:40.327] Does that make me crazy?
[00:44.368] Does that make me crazy?
[00:48.632] Possibly

[00:54.925] And I hope that you are having the time of your life
[01:01.866] But think twice, that's my only advice

[01:11.335] Come on now, who do you, who do you, who do you, who do you think you are,
[01:17.317] Ha ha ha bless your soul
[01:22.555] You really think you're in control

[01:26.826] Well, I think you're crazy
[01:31.498] I think you're crazy
[01:35.545] I think you're crazy
[01:40.064] Just like me

[01:46.247] My heroes had the heart to lose their lives out on a limb
[01:53.321] And all I remember is thinking, I want to be like them
[02:02.917] Ever since I was little, ever since I was little it looked like fun
[02:08.866] And it's no coincidence I've come
[02:14.055] And I can die when I'm done

[02:18.679] Maybe I'm crazy
[02:22.826] Maybe you're crazy
[02:27.084] Maybe we're crazy
[02:31.352] Probably

[02:52.917] Uh, uh
